name: Hazuki Shino
source:
A nurse that assists [url=/c4655]Takumi[/url]'s [url=/c4670]doctor[/url].

[spoiler]She is [url=/c4663]Grimm[/url] and also the serial killer behind most of the New-Gen cases.
She will be wearing glasses if Takumi decides that he prefers glasses girls while talking to Grimm at the start of the story.
She is a member of the cult detective Ban is investigating, known as the "Cosmic Church of the Divine Light". She kills herself by driving a stake used in the third New-Gen case into her throat.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chaos;Head]Wikipedia[/url]]
